purpose: FirstBella MXF header capability and workflow review, comparing installedMediaComposer/MDVx/currentMediaMuster and ten actual initialheaders.
status: MDB version baseline approved separately. Subsequent Duration/Original Bin fallback revision approved; other MXF recommendations remain review proposals. No scanner implementation.

mediaComposer.method: Read-only installed arm64 symbol and selective disassembly audit, including native scanner entry points and cached AAF-MXF adapter. No application/private API execution, no corpus/media/database modification, no runtime performance measurement, no implementation edits.

evidence: LocalMDB calls MXFDomain::New at 0x41ba48, tests operational pattern through IsOPAtom at 0x41ba6c and IsNullOperationalPattern at 0x41ba94, with other pattern failure MXFDomain_INIT_FAILED. Null operational pattern is an observed compatibility branch, not a recommendation to accept arbitrary unqualified MXFs.
MSMDB calls MXFDomain::New at 0x44e3d4 and corresponding IsOPAtom/IsNullOperationalPattern at 0x44e3f8/0x44e420. It has a diagnostic unexpected number of master mobs, found %d expected 1 at 0x44e6c4.

LocalMDB obtains AAFTranslationTable at 0x41bad4 and MobEnumerator at 0x41baf8, adds each mob at 0x41bb40, queries SourceMob/physical FileDescriptor interfaces, classifies physical/master branches, converts full mob IDs through ConvertMobID at 0x41bbf4 and reads internal physical descriptors in later branches. Required descriptor and stream-offset checks exist at 0x41bf9c and 0x41bfe4.
findings.meaning: Native scanner reads an AAF-MXF metadata object model with qualified mob/descriptor relationships; it does not just take the first package or first matching byte pattern.

evidence: Read path creates MXFCachePageAllocator 0x470924 and AAFCreateRawStorageCached2 at 0x47097c, then AAFCreateAAFFileOnRawStorage at 0x4709f8. The missing/error diagnostics explicitly call this the cached-disk Raw Storage object for reading.

Opens AAF-MXF file for reading at interface call 0x470a64; obtains header at 0x470ee8, dictionary at 0x470f54, constructs AAFMCDefinitions at 0x470f94, initializes MXF property extensions and Avid typedefs at 0x470fa8/0x470fb4.
LoadAAFLibrary loads @executable_path/libcom-api.dylib at 0x48f9c..fa0, then /Library/Application Support/Avid/libcom-api.dylib fallback at 0x48fb4..fb8.
Further initialization enumerates essence-data objects and has checks No essence data present, Only one essence data object per file supported, and Failed to count essence stream segments.
findings.meaning: The traced modern native reader uses cached random-access file storage and a richer retained object model rather than reading the entire potentially multi-GB MXF into a single byte buffer. This does not prove a fixed maximum amount of data read or that no essence/index bytes are ever touched.

evidence: restore(OMFile&) tests partitions and fill at 0x1b15b8/0x1b15e8, creates attached root/class-factory/dictionary objects, loops metadata until endsMetadata at 0x1b1944, and throws Failed to read key while parsing metadata or Failed to find valid metadata.
readPrimerPack reads count/element-size words at 0x1b5414/0x1b542c, loops local-tag and key entries at 0x1b5478/0x1b5494, converts identifiers, and adds dictionary mappings at 0x1b54d4.
flatRestore maps local property tags through dictionary 0x1b3950, checks allowed/present properties 0x1b3a14/0x1b3a24, dispatches stored forms and builds strong references/vectors/sets.

readKLVLength parses short/long-form BER and compares the long-form width with 8 at 0x1c50fc; importantly, this check occurs after a raw read into temporary stack storage at 0x1c50ec. This is not evidence of fully safe validation and should not be copied blindly. readHeaderPartition reads partition fields and container labels via typed storage methods.
findings.meaning: These are explicit installed toolkit MXF/KLV/primer/relationship implementations in the library the native MXFDomain loads, not generic MDB/Bento routines. Full dynamic dispatch from every open through every concrete storage version was not reconstructed.

evidence: Obtains typed header object, reads kAAFPropID_MXFHeaderMasterMobID at 0x478f30 and kAAFPropID_MXFHeaderEssenceFileMobID at 0x478f54 through GetMobIDPropFromObject. Reads kAAFPropID_MXFHeaderProjectName through GetStringPropFromObject at 0x478f78.
MakeCMMobID conversions at 0x478fc8/0x478fec copy complete two-128-bit results into 32-byte destination IDs at 0x478fd4/0x478ff8.
Project typed Unicode string is passed through AvText(PKw,...) at 0x479014 then native char conversion. This is not evidence that raw MXF standard strings use PMR MacRoman or MDB UTF-8 encoding.
findings.meaning: Avid MXFs may carry convenient Avid-specific header summary IDs and Project text. This does not establish that every third-party Avid-compatible OP-Atom carries them, or that this helper is unconditionally preferred over package graph identity in all native callers.

findings.scope: technical metadata after native MXF object decoding
evidence: Previously traced base physical descriptor imports own Length through IAAFFileDescriptor +0x20 and own SampleRate through +0x40, with typed conversion ConvertAAFEditRate at 0x17ca48.
DIDDescriptor calls that base and imports digital-image descriptor fields through the typed interface, with specialised Avid/MPEG paths.
AudioMediaDesc has typed audio descriptor reads and ConvertAAFEditRate at 0x362c68; full concrete-field policies are not derived from this one overview.
findings.meaning: Bella can read compact qualified typed MXF properties when a header is independently opened, but this research does not reopen the approved Duration MDB-only rule. Explicit header rationals should not be decimalized then reinterpreted as legacy MDB decimal aliases.

findings.scope: separate older native low-level reader, not conflated with modern scanner
evidence: GetHeaderFromFile allocates min(fileLength,8192) bytes at 0x47af8c..9c, reads initial bytes at 0x47afbc, calls incremental ParseNLEMXFHeader at 0x47afe0; return 1 reads next up-to-8192 bytes at 0x47b01c and loops. Frees temporary buffer at 0x47b044.
Parser has explicit label-based branches for partition/preface/content/package/track/sequence/sourceclip/timecode/video/audio-related sets and retains split-chunk state.
findings.meaning: A chunked reader exists in the installed native library. The traced modern LocalMDB/MSMDB entry points instead use MXFDomain cached AAF-MXF initialization; do not present this helper as the proven whole modern scanner implementation or as Bella concurrency-safe reference code.

bellaImplicationsInference: Preserve existing Avid-compatible OP-Atom scope, including known compatible third-party writers; do not grow this into a full edit/playback MXF engine.
Use a seekable bounded KLV metadata reader and the file Primer mappings to identify properties; retain full relevant package/MobID and descriptor/track ownership.
Read only metadata ranges needed for approved fields, skip essence payload by validated lengths and do not load the whole MXF.
Keep final compact typed values, release per-file buffers/indexes at end; do not recreate all native graph/cache/index/playback state.
Exact header-open triggers and source priorities remain separately approved decisions. No missing field alone authorizes opening a header; Duration remains MDB-only under current requirements.
limits: Static selected-function audit, not exhaustive decompilation of Media Composer or all supported MXF versions/codecs.
No runtime reading/crash/performance test, and no claim actual corpus text values match a particular reader. Root owns real header corpus and public format references.
No proof every file kind uses the same closed/complete-header, footer-priority or native fallback rule; those require scoped independent format/field evidence.
No new Bella rules approved by this receipt; root integrates current requirements and user decisions.

The native code is a behavioral reference, not a model for defensive parsing. Observed KLV-length validation order alone does not establish malformed-input safety; no runtime defect is claimed or tested.

mdvx.method: Read-only arm64 nm/otool disassembly of installed MDVx; static Mach-O CFString/constant symbol resolution. No app/private API/malformed file executions or media writes.

entryPoints.finding: Requires file exists, a stored path, mxf extension, ScanMXF preference exactly 1, and file size >=1025 bytes; uses MDVxMediafile and calls open/addInfo without checking open return.
MDB object presence selects addInfoToItem branch; without MDB object, an existing physical item whose NameInBin is nil calls corresponding-file fallback. Not a blanket mandatory read for every file.

NSFileHandle -> fdopen rb -> ami_read_info(FILE*,&MXFinfo,1). Builds four-value dictionary only: clipname/project/fileUID/matUID. Success path frees ami_info; return ultimately tests FILE* non-null rather than ami metadata success.

ioAndLifetime.strategy: Buffered FILE stream, parsing KLV structure through embedded libMXF/avidmxfinfo. Does not load whole physical MXF into a single NSData buffer.
ioAndLifetime.initialHeader: ami_read_info at 0x10000ff0c..0x10000ff50 wraps FILE then calls mxf_read_header_pp_kl (0x10000b69c), mxf_read_partition (0x10000aa14), and explicitly requires mxf_is_op_atom. Header KLV must begin at current stream start; the distinct with_runin helper is not called.
ioAndLifetime.metadataRegion: 0x10000ff78..0x10000ffcc skips initial filler KLVs, requires header metadata/primer, and passes partition HeaderByteCount at offset0x30 to mxf_avid_read_filtered_header_metadata. That reader calls 0x100045c74, parses known metadata sets through declared HeaderByteCount and requires exact consumed count. No fixed first-N-MB cap found in this ordinary route.
ioAndLifetime.bytesRead: Cannot report a single byte number for all files from static code: partition pack, primer, set/item values depend on declared lengths; fillers/unknown items/sets may be skipped via seek. Underlying disk read uses fread at 0x100008540. No media payload decoding identified.
ioAndLifetime.noRecovery: ami_read_info contains no footer/RIP finder or body-partition search calls. Therefore cannot claim footer-only metadata or leading-run-in support in this ordinary path.
ioAndLifetime.memory: Header reader allocates recognized set/item structures with per-item payload copies (mxf_read_item 0x100046360); it is not a zero-copy targeted four-property parser. ami_read_info frees header metadata, model, partition, scratch lists and closes FILE on both common cleanup branches 0x100010828 and0x100011ac8. MDVxMXF copies selected strings/IDs to Objective-C dictionary then ami_free_info at0x10003266c releases remaining returned strings/tags.

encoding.projectFallback: PrefaceProjectName checked at0x10000ffe8; ifproject pointer remains null0x1000100d0 branches0x100010664, reads material MobAttributeList and gets attribute _PJ via0x10001069c; converted toUTF8.

identity.fullLengthRead: mxf_get_umid_item0x10004974c requires length exactly32 and copies32 bytes. MDVxMXF dictionary copies32 at0x100032578 and0x1000325f4.
identity.normalisation: swapUUIDfromMXFtoMDVx0x100032808 preserves bytes0..15, reverses16..19, swaps20..21 and22..23, preserves24..31. RequiresNSData length32; otherwise returns zeroed32 buffer.
identity.matchingLimit: Ordinary downstream MDB/bin comparisons use MDVx eight-byte UID excerpt described in retained identity audit; copying full IDs here does not establish full-ID matching throughout app.

damageAndUnknown: Primitive KLV read failures, invalid OP-Atom, no usable primer or required packages, broken required typed fields cause ami_read_info error cleanup; ordinary wrapper logs Failed to open/read header/not OP-Atom/read info.

Unknown set class in mxf_read_and_return_set0x100046170 seeks over declared set length and returns2; unregistered tag logs warning then skips bounded item; unrecognized item definition skips its declared value. This is supported unknown data rather than immediate whole-header rejection.

Static gaps: openFile success is FILE* presence despite parser error; addInfo caller does not gate on return; swap of absent/wrong-length ID yields zeroed32. NSString conversion failure becomes empty value with warning on successpath. Do not treat these behaviors as Bella correctness rules.
No damaged fixture executed, crash/non-crash/complete memory safety not established.

mediaMuster.audit: Current MediaMuster OldScanner MXF read-only source audit for Bella requirements
mediaMuster.scope: Source and existing test inspection only; no build/tests/apps/media write, no repo mutations

findings.fact: ScanCoordinator calls prepareMxf for MXF candidates; prepareMxf opens QFile ReadOnly once, invokes MxfReader, then projectMxf. The oldscanner wrapper still uses ScanEngine.

Does not read whole MXF into memory. Known-size seekable QIODevice; checks offsets, sizes, cancellation; physical reads use 16,384-byte scratch array. Walks KLV framing from permitted run-in to EOF; advances next position by declared KLV extent, seeks over essence, index, Fill, unknown nonlocal header/body payloads. Reads Partition/Primer/RIP/Avid object-directory payload and all local-set property payloads inside declared header metadata. Thus byte I/O excludes large essence payloads but logical whole-file KLV walk may cause many small seek/read calls. No fixed first-N-byte or 64MiB metadata cutoff.

Understands version-1 PartitionPack layout, header/body/footer partition framing, 2-byte tag+2-byte-length local sets (0x53), 2-byte tag+BER-length (0x13), exact Avid private root 0x53 convention. HeaderByteCount scopes metadata; each partition has its own Primer and reference identities. Primer maps local tags to registered property ULs; no tag-number-only guess. Generic wider MXF class catalogue exists but product scope is Avid-compatible OP-Atom including third-party Avid media.

Registered property type selects decoding. Standard package Name and private Preface.ProjectName are UTF-16 big-endian; fixed numeric types/rationals generally big-endian. Avid Indirect values use exact verified type/byte-order prefixes for UTF-16 BE/LE or Int32. Strict malformed UTF-16/UTF-8 detection; unknown Indirect preserved uninterpreted. Do not carry PMR/MDB MacRoman fallback indiscriminately into MXF.

Active Preface.ContentStorage membership plus EssenceContainerData.LinkedPackageUID uniquely identifies file SourcePackage.PackageUID. Associated MaterialPackage must explicitly refer to file SourcePackage through tracks/SourceClip graph for master association. Preface IDs corroborate and do not replace missing ownership. MXF UMID is full 32-byte identifier; normalization swaps material numeric fields to application convention, not eight-byte truncation. InstanceUID is separate 16-byte object reference identity, scoped to one partition copy. Ambiguous IDs/references do not choose first target.

MxfReader constructs raw objects, raw per-field bytes, relationship graph and decoding context, then compacts shared storage. prepareMxf projects immediately and moves only source receipt: raw graph destroyed on return. Projection observations retain selected rawValue per fact, text encodings and provenance; projections stored for matching throughout scan. Final oldscanner wrapper builds detached UI rows and destroys temporary session at completion. Thus current implementation already releases broad raw graph after each source, but not all per-fact evidence until end of scan.

Current requiredTableMetadata gate can open MXF when required table fields (including current Duration, ClipName, Project, etc) missing/conflicting or database match not complete/usable. Missing OriginalBin alone deliberately does not open MXF because coverage unestablished; SourcePath still participates currently. Bella excludes recorded SourcePath and enforces MDB-only Duration plus MDB-first FPS with header only when independently read. Do not inherit current generic completeness gate or header-duration recovery. Header loop sequential in this path.

Tests cover relocated/ambiguous Primer, repeated partition reference scopes, typed UTF16/rational/Indirect byte order, malformed lengths, ambiguous IDs, IO/cancellation/changed size, range-only unknown payload, unsupported majorversion and broad shared-storage lifetime. Sparse 5GiB essence test asserts no essence payload read and total bytes<16384. Source-preparation tests use genuine header excerpts, compare projection and assert independence after source bytes/file removed. These are source-derived test coverage observations, not a new test run.

fieldCapabilities.source: Owned SourcePackage.PackageUID, active EssenceContainerData.LinkedPackageUID; Preface.EssenceFileMobID corroboration
Track/SourceClip-linked MaterialPackage.PackageUID and GenericPackage.Name. Preface.MasterMobID eligible only if graph association exists.
Private Preface.ProjectName and linked package TaggedValue names _PJ or PROJNAME. These have scoped ownership, not arbitrary text search.
Owned sound/picture descriptor class, or registered Primer-mapped sound/picture property on newer uncatalogued descriptor. Both audio+video means unresolved.
Video FileDescriptor.SampleRate exact rational. Bella: MDB first, fallback only when MDBunusable AND header already independently read.
GenericSoundEssenceDescriptor.AudioSamplingRate, separate from descriptor stream-unit SampleRate; ChannelCount available as support fact.
Audio QuantizationBits; picture ComponentDepth or RGBA PixelLayout. Coding refines DNx Uncompressed sentinels/float/fixed meanings; AlphaSampleDepth supports alpha metadata.

PictureEssenceCoding/SoundEssenceCompression label, EssenceContainer wrapping, ResolutionID plus descriptor facts/rate into current shared verified compressionNames catalogue; Wave/AES3 PCM inference only qualified absence.
Stored/Sampled/Display geometry and offsets, FrameLayout, narrow verified Avid proxy rule; current code formats WxH early. Bella can store numeric geometry and generate label later.

Established master AppCode and standard UsageCode; direct _IMPORTSETTING and immediate tracks under qualified linked MaterialPackage for precompute category. Bella requires preserve agreed 1/7 mapping and no unsupported default assumptions.

fieldCapabilities.field: Duration and Drop Frame capability, excluded for Bella Duration
fieldCapabilities.source: Current code supports own descriptor ContainerDuration/SampleRate, linked-filetrack fallback, owned timecode DF. Bella table Duration explicitly MDB only even header already read: do not store or choose header duration merely because current parser knows it.

fieldCapabilities.field: Recorded SourcePath capability, excluded for Bella
fieldCapabilities.source: Current code traverses origins/import locators and UNCPath. Bella uses physical path only; do not recreate this graph solely for excluded source paths.

No OriginalBin, Effect, EffectCategory or EffectSequence projection in current mxfprojection.cpp. Do not promise supported MXF source for these without fresh evidence. EffectSequence excluded entirely in Bella.

fieldCapabilities.source: Filesystem facts, not MXF package names/creation dates; no need to retain MXF dates for them.

bellaRecommendation: Keep independent small MXF reader for Avid-compatible OP-Atom; do not expand to general-purpose MXF nor preserve all private fields merely because old Canon did.

Open once when separately authorized by field/source policy. Read necessary metadata by checked seeks; never load full media or essence samples. Metadata need not reside entirely at offsetzero; establish supported layout before early exit.
Use each partition Primer property mapping and registered encoding, full typed ID normalization and explicit file/master/descriptor ownership.

Retain compact agreed field values and just support facts necessary for verified compression/geometry/depth; release temporary buffer/indexes. Avoid all-property evidence graph in fresh Bella runtime.

Preserve existing verified compression resolver and interpretation rules/tests with small new helpers; keep DurationMDBonly and specialFPSfallback. Defer exact navigation optimization and concurrency until evidence+benchmarks.
limits: No new performance measurement; cannot infer speedup percentage.
No runtime negative-corpus verification this turn.
General MXF format capabilities in current reader exceed approved product scope; presence in catalogue does not prove all codecs/thirdpartyvariants supported.
Source facts establish capabilities, not the final still-deferred Bella source-priority table.

observedHeaders.scope: Read-only selected first-header observations of one audio/video file per available Avid media directory; no essence decoding, file writes or production parser execution.
limits: Subset selected by filename suffix for sampling only; actual descriptor class remains recorded separately.
One initial partition/header only; no footer/index/essence payload inspection or all-file conformance claim.

Selected property observations are not a complete file/master association or ID normalization proof.

existingBellaPolicies.physicalInventory: Every supported physical media file stays listed, even without usable databases/headers. Preserve full-ID/KelpieId rules; do not gate inventory on header metadata.
existingBellaPolicies.productScope: Existing approved Avid-compatible OP-Atom, including third-party Avid media. A generic library capability is not permission to expand scope to arbitraryMXF. Proven Avid compatibility forms must be reviewed rather than excluded by an unqualified strict-conformance gate.
existingBellaPolicies.duration: Prefer usable own MDB Length/SampleRate and qualified display facts. When the scan falls back to MXF because usable database information is unavailable, use coherent own physical MXF duration and qualified timing/display facts. This exception does not request an open solely for Duration or verification of usable MDB timing. PMR absence alone does not displace usable MDB timing. Exact header-opening conditions remain deferred. Preserve coherent source timing; MXF clock/DF qualification remains under review.
existingBellaPolicies.frameRate: Own usable MDB SampleRate first. A usable already-read MXF rate is fallback only when MDB unusable and header opening independently required. Missing Frame Rate never opens a header. Header FPS alone does not repair an MDB Duration pair; separately eligible MXF Duration uses coherent own timing.
existingBellaPolicies.physicalFacts: Filename/FilePath/Size/DateCreated remain physical filesystem facts. Recorded SourcePath and EffectSequence remain excluded.
existingBellaPolicies.compression: Preserve current shared compression resolver/catalogue and visible behavior. Carry only the coding/descriptor/rate facts it needs.
existingBellaPolicies.priorityAndScheduling: Full source priorities and reasons for opening headers are deferred. FourPMR/fourMDB maxima do not silently choose MXF concurrency.
existingBellaPolicies.staging: FreshC++17/Qt6.5.3 Bella implementation after requirements review; OldScanner remains active until explicit cutover approval; BinFilter unchanged.
existingBellaPolicies.originalBin: Leave blank on database-unavailable MXF fallback; no guessed bin name or header search. Preserve separately usable selected-master MDB Original Bin.

recommendedBellaMxf.status: Duration on database-unavailable MXF fallback and blank Original Bin on that fallback are approved. Other field mappings/navigation remain proposals.
recommendedBellaMxf.io: Open only when an independently authorized scan reason requires a header. For ordinary closed/complete Avid-compatible OPAtom, use validated initial HeaderByteCount/Primer and selected linked records; avoid unconditional all-file KLV walk. No whole media-file RAM image, essence decoding, playback-index expansion or fixed first-N-MB guess.
recommendedBellaMxf.resourceSafety: Read validated metadata in bounded chunks into scoped temporary ownership; do not allocate/read untrusted HeaderByteCount blindly or allow an oversized declaration to treat known recording payload as metadata. Exact compatibility/recovery/resource policies need focused follow-up.
recommendedBellaMxf.selection: Use Primer propertyUL identities, required active membership and complete identities to select the actual essence file package, explicitly linked material/master and owned descriptors. Optional Avid summary IDs are useful evidence, not universal authority or a reason to skip ownership checks.

readAndKeep.facts: Full32-byte FileMobId and qualified MasterMobId; temporary object/reference indexes; existing normalization helper and full equality.
Qualified linked package Name; Preface.ProjectName and proven relevant project tagged values. Internal source preference/blank/conflict handling reviewed field by field.
Own qualified sound/picture descriptor family; Audio/Video/unknown vocabulary preserved; exact mapping reviewed separately.

Own exact SampleRate rational; supported stored/sampled/display geometry, offsets and FrameLayout; coding label/ResolutionID/component orRGBA layout needed for current Compression/Resolution/BitDepth rules.
Own AudioSamplingRate rational, QuantizationBits and only necessary sample-format/channel/coding context.

Own qualified physical duration/count and rate with necessary display clock/DF facts. Preserve exact count/rate and audio samples. Precise MXF owner/clock/DF rules need focused review; do not apply legacy MDB conversion indiscriminately.

Qualified linked master AppCode/UsageCode and direct support facts where present. Keep approved Type1/7 behavior; named Effect/Category handling continues through the agreed shared resolver, not a speculative new graph.
Leave blank on database-unavailable MXF fallback; no guessed bin name or header search. Preserve separately usable selected-master MDB Original Bin. Reliable MXF mapping is not established.

recommendedBellaMxf.text: Standard package strings and supported Avid Preface.ProjectName are UTF16BE. Known Avid indirect tagged values have type/order prefixes. Follow declared supported layouts, not blanket UTF8/MacRoman or platform heuristics. Exact field fallback remains review work.
recommendedBellaMxf.lifetime: After required relationships/fields are interpreted, retain only compact owned strings, complete binaryIDs, exact numerics and necessary availability/format context. Release header capture/indexes; no unused private-property/metadictionary graph or permanent per-byte provenance.
